title: Nvidia announces jaw-dropping $150 billion stock buyback, largest single authorization in history - Yahoo Finance

title: Five men arrested near RAF Fairford on suspicion of terror offences were UK nationals from London - bbc.com
description: The men, who all live in London, were arrested near the base on Sunday morning. Residents say security had been stepped up in the days before.

title: A wild NFL Sunday saved its craziest seven seconds for Brazil - washingtonpost.com
description: Thirteen of the 14 games played Sunday were within one score in the fourth quarter, and 12 were decided by eight points or fewer. Six teams scored the winning points in the final three minutes.

title: Saudi Arabia’s Crucial Oil Pipeline Starts Exports After Repairs - Bloomberg
description: Saudi Arabia has started exporting oil using a key cross-country pipeline after the link was repaired following drone strikes earlier this month, a person with direct knowledge of the matter said.
